reviewedBy: Task 117 Part G — operator-reviewed domain curation

policy.rationale: Only domains with a verified application purpose or a documented editorial review are fetchable. A domain appearing in an LLM-generated response is NEVER sufficient grounds for inclusion.
policy.enforcement: fetchArticleSecure() rejects any host not matched below BEFORE any network request; the mode can be switched to monitor-only via NEWS_ALLOWLIST_MODE=monitor for one review cycle.

globalRules.ipChecks: every resolved A/AAAA must be public (loopback/link-local/private/ULA/CGNAT/metadata/6to4 rejected); every redirect hop fully re-validated (DNS-rebinding resistant)
globalRules.pdfPolicy: application/pdf is NOT an allowed content type — article fetches are HTML/text only; unexpected file types rejected
globalRules.credentials: never forwarded; no cookies; public User-Agent only
globalRules.userProvidedUrls: accepted only from beta participants via /api/llm/interpret-news and only when the host is allowlisted
